'''Shar Honelle''' was a city in [[Aelgar]], part of the [[Ten Nations]]. It is not known if any current cities are built at or near Shar Honelle.

The translation from the [[List of Old Tongue words|Old Tongue]] is unknown, although ''Shar'' means "blood" or "bloodline", so the full name may refer to the heritage of the nation. Modern day Tarabon, which shares some territory with ancient Aelgar, claims heritage from the [[Age of Legends]], so there may be a link there.
